reading.title: My First Phone
reading.text: For my birthday I got a mobile phone. I was very happy! Dad showed me how to charge it and how to save a phone number. At school I must switch off my phone in class. Yesterday my phone rang during lunch. It was my grandma. I answered the phone and we talked for ten minutes. Before she hung up, she said, "Don't forget to charge your phone!"

listening.title: The Old Telephone
listening.script: In my grandpa's house there is an old telephone. It is black and heavy. When the phone rings, it makes a very loud sound. Grandpa picks up the phone and says, "Hello?" He cannot take it outside, because it is not a mobile phone. He likes to talk on the phone with his old friends for a long time. At night he hangs up and says, "Time for tea."

reading.title: A Quick Call
reading.text: Last night my phone rang at nine o'clock. It was my cousin Jasur. He said, "Can I give you a call tomorrow?" I said, "Yes, but please call me before school." It was a short call. This morning I had two missed calls on my phone, but they were from my aunt. I called her back. She wanted to know if we needed a taxi to the airport. Mum said, "Yes, please call a taxi for six o'clock."

listening.script: Last week our neighbour fell in his garden and could not stand up. His wife made a call at once. She called the doctor and a taxi too. The doctor came in ten minutes. He said it was not serious. The neighbour is called Mr Rustam, and he is seventy years old. Later, his wife gave my mum a call to say thank you.

reading.text: Last summer we went to the mountains. My dad took his new digital camera. He took many photographs of the lakes and trees. I took a photo of a small goat. reading.text: Every Friday we have a film night at home. First, Dad rents a DVD from the shop. Then he puts the DVD in the DVD player. Last week we watched a funny film about a talking dog. My little brother laughed a lot. After the film, we made a short video of ourselves. We recorded it on Mum's phone. Then we had a video call with Grandma and showed her the video.

reading.title: Busy Weeks
reading.text: This week is very busy for me. I have swimming lessons once a week, and each lesson lasts an hour. Yesterday the bus was ten minutes late, so I waited for half an hour. Next month I will have a big exam, so I study every evening. A year ago I could not swim at all! Now I can swim for hours. My teacher says I will be a champion in two years.

reading.title: Free Time
reading.text: I do not have much free time on school days. But on Saturdays I like to spend time with my friends. Last weekend we had a good time at the park. We played football for a long time. My friend was late, but he came in time for the game. He said, "Sorry, I did not want to waste time." We always try to be on time. In the evening Mum asked, "What time is it? Come home now!"

listening.title: Be on Time
listening.script: Our teacher says we must be on time. Yesterday I got up late, and I ran to school. I got there just in time for the first lesson. I was lucky! My friend Aziz was five minutes late. The teacher said, "Please do not waste time in the morning." Today I got up early. I had enough time for breakfast. I also had time to feed my cat.
